thread:
Carmen Li: opened PR to add Helm/templating snippets to the Private installer docs so teams can pre-fill KMS host and HSM device via values.yaml and Jinja helpers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/558
Omar Farouk: nice. can you include a minimal values.yaml example and a Jinja snippet showing fallback to env var? folks run into missing module path when deploying via CI.
Carmen Li: adding examples. values.yaml:
```yaml
kms:
  host: kms.internal
  port: 443
hsm:
  device: /dev/hsm0
  pkcs11_module: /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
```
Jinja helper (docs):
```jinja
{% set hsm_device = values.hsm.device or (env.REDWOOD_HSM_DEVICE | default('/dev/hsm0')) %}
```
Nina Patel: please also add a tiny SDK snippet for Go and TypeScript showing reading env vars for PKCS11 module path so integrators can mirror Helm behavior. keeps things consistent.
Omar Farouk: and a short migration note: installer v1.0 used /dev/hsm, v1.2 expects /dev/hsm0. include a one-liner to create a symlink for in-place upgrades: `ln -s /dev/hsm /dev/hsm0` and a udev rule sample.
Carmen Li: udev snippet added:
```bash
# /etc/udev/rules.d/99-redwood-hsm.rules
KERNEL=="hsm0", SUBSYSTEM=="char", MODE="0660", GROUP="hsm", OWNER="root"
```
Omar Farouk: add systemd drop-in for the installer service so CI runners can set REDWOOD_* env vars without editing unit file. small example please.
Carmen Li: done:
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/offline-installer.service.d/env.conf
[Service]
Environment=REDWOOD_KMS_HOST=kms.internal REDWOOD_HSM_DEVICE=/dev/hsm0
```
Nina Patel: include compact verification commands (nc/curl/openssl) and a quick log excerpt showing two typical failures (missing CA and CKR_GENERAL_ERROR) so readers know what to look for.
Carmen Li: added checks:
```bash
nc -vz kms.internal 443
curl -v --connect-timeout 5 https://kms.internal:443 || true
openssl s_client -connect kms.internal:443 -showcerts
```
log excerpt from staging dry-run:
```text
2026-06-18T09:10:02Z installer: template render ok
2026-06-18T09:10:03Z tls: curl -> x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
2026-06-18T09:10:05Z kms: PKCS11_OpenSession() failed: CKR_GENERAL_ERROR
```
Omar Farouk: tiny ask: call out permission checks (`ls -l /dev/hsm0`) and recommend not loosening to 666; prefer group=hsm + chmod 660.
Carmen Li: added note and udev+systemd pointers. updated PR description and TOC anchor.
